Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread IMDb’s Gaza Ghetto release info, interpreting the Denmark date “January 22, 1988” as 1998, and then concluded that Gaza Ghetto (1998) was more recent than Kull the Conqueror (1997). This misreading, combined with an incorrect comparison criterion (using the latest international release rather than the standard/earliest release year), led to the wrong interim conclusion, contradicting the gathered evidence that places Gaza Ghetto in 1985/1988 and Kull in 1997.
